notes: Entirely business-type entity (City of Wahoo Combined Municipal Utilities Fund: Electric, Water, Sewer, Gas), accrual basis, year ended December 31, 2023. Receipts/disbursements from the Statements of Revenues and Expenses 2023 column (p2); no single total printed, so reported totals = operating + nonoperating (computed). Beginning net position = 2022 Total Net Position on p1 (no separate changes-in-net-position statement in the trim); 21,275,103 + 613,871 = 21,888,974. Grant Revenue and Contributions in Aid of Construction are '-' for 2023 and Transfers to City '-'. Salaries, Wages & Benefits lines put under Salaries and Wages and Maintenance & Supplies under Repairs and Maintenance (mixed lines). Proprietary cash flows: the investing section's net line is printed as 'Net cash provided (used) by financing activities' (1,164,754); recorded as investing. Detail from the per-department schedules (pp7-10); the combining schedule (p5) shows the same figures by column and is not recorded again; p6 is the 2022 combining schedule (prior year, not recorded). Read pages 1-10 of 10
